independent_clause: Independent restriction R1: digital/social advertising is prohibited for A001 for StudioA; this restriction survives any amendment to the use grant.

citations.quote: Fictional authorized licensor and StudioA agree: for A001, this amendment supersedes only L1 restrictions conflicting with paid commercial advertising on digital/social advertising channels worldwide including New Zealand, from 2026-01-01 through 2027-12-31.
